goals.requirement: A mobile assembly has actually supplied a span across gap-west–gap-east and, AFTER actually spanning, traveled through low-west plus low-east or lower-west plus lower-east, and now stands at gap-east or destination while a real usable gap crossing remains. goals.title: Two skies
goals.requirement: One actual rootbed at bed is enclosed, clean-water-fed and illuminated in both opposing sky rows. Static dual sources, actual reflected light or any other legal assembly may work; no controller is prescribed.

goals.title: Two viewpoints
goals.requirement: At alcove, actual records of spire observed from west-view and east-view are inside actual dust-protected containment. The place itself supplies darkness, not a covering; a supported mesh screen is a valid dust cover and need not be sealed. A single camera moved between views is valid. Copies of an unobserving camera do not acquire either record.

goals.title: Still and growing place
goals.requirement: At bed, an actual enclosed illuminated rootbed receives clean water originating at one of this map’s real source places. Keep a dry walk from walk-start to walk-end. The clean source is a legal alternative to purification.

goals.title: Drying and preservation

goals.title: Bright protected garden
goals.requirement: At bed, an actual rootbed is enclosed, illuminated and receiving clean water in the day row. Any construction satisfying those properties works.

goals.requirement: The northern receiver has actually received the bed location through an optical event, and the bed garden is currently functioning. Both goals may complete together.
